proof_body:
by
  intro R S _ _ _ _ hinj
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Order.krullDim_le_of_strictMono (fun Q : PrimeSpectrum S => (⟨Q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S), inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)) ?_
    intro Q Q' h
    have hlt : Q.asIdeal < Q'.asIdeal := h
    obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hlt
    exact Ideal.comap_lt_comap_of_integral_mem_sdiff (R := R) (I := Q.asIdeal) (J := Q'.asIdeal) hlt.le ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)
  · have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : PrimeSpectrum R) (Q : PrimeSpectrum S), Q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S) = p.asIdeal → (n : ℕ∞) ≤ Order.coheight p → (n : ℕ∞) ≤ Order.coheight Q := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intros; simp
      | succ n ih =>
        intro p Q hQ hn
        obtain ⟨s, hhead, hlen⟩ := Order.exists_series_of_le_coheight p hn
        let i : Fin (s.length + 1) := ⟨1, by omega⟩
        have hlt : p < s i := by
          have : s.head < s i := s.strictMono (by simp [Fin.lt_def, i])
          rwa [hhead] at this
        have hle : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ Order.coheight (s i) := by
          refine le_trans ?_ (Order.rev_index_le_coheight s i)
          have : ((i.rev : Fin _) : ℕ) = n := by simp [Fin.rev, i]; omega
          rw [this]
        have hlt' : p.asIdeal < (s i).asIdeal := hlt
        have hIQ : Q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S) ≤ (s i).asIdeal := by rw [hQ]; exact hlt'.le
        obtain ⟨Q', hQ1, hQ2, hQ3⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime (R := R) (s i).asIdeal Q.asIdeal hIQ
        let Q'' : PrimeSpectrum S := ⟨Q', hQ2⟩
        have hQlt : Q < Q'' := by
          refine lt_of_le_of_ne hQ1 ?_
          intro h
          have : Q.asIdeal = Q' := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h
          rw [← this, hQ] at hQ3
          exact hlt'.ne hQ3
        have := ih (s i) Q'' hQ3 hle
        calc ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) = (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by push_cast; rfl
          _ ≤ Order.coheight Q'' + 1 := by gcongr
          _ ≤ Order.coheight Q := Order.coheight_add_one_le hQlt
    show Order.krullDim (PrimeSpectrum R) ≤ Order.krullDim (PrimeSpectrum S)
    rw [Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight, Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight]
    refine iSup_le fun p => ?_
    have hker : Ideal.comap (algebraMap R S) ⊥ ≤ p.asIdeal := by
      intro x hx
      have : algebraMap R S x = 0 := by simpa using hx
      have : x = 0 := hinj (by simpa using this)
      rw [this]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
    obtain ⟨Q, -, hQp, hQ⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral (R := R) p.asIdeal (⊥ : Ideal S) hker
    refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup _ (⟨Q, hQp⟩ : PrimeSpectrum S))
    refine WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 ?_
    exact ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le.1 fun n hn => key n p ⟨Q, hQp⟩ hQ hn
target_source: ∀ (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S], Function.Injective (algebraMap R S) → ringKrullDim S = ringKrullDim R
